chunks: And Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:

Concerning a man who freed his slave on the condition that he marry him to his daughter, and stipulated upon him that if he married another woman or took a concubine besides her, then such-and-such would be due from him.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to free a slave on the condition that he marries one's daughter and accepts further marital restrictions?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on a conditional manumission tied to marriage and a further stipulation restricting additional marital or concubinary relations. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام rules that such a condition is valid and permissible. The report is relevant to questions of emancipation, contractual stipulations, and family law.
